boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten named UNT Libraries environments for quiet individual work, group sessions, presentations, and research with physical collections.

cards.title: Willis Library Lower Level
cards.subtitle: Willis Library · quiet individual study
cards.notes: Take the central staircase, a corner stairwell, or the main elevator down, then keep calls, conversation, and group work for another floor.
cards.short_summary: A designated quiet floor for individual study, research, and focused work.
cards.evidence_claim: UNT Libraries designates the Willis Library Lower Level as a quiet floor for study, research, and individual work, with no calls, group gatherings, or conversation.
cards.source_title: Willis Library: Lower Level | UNT University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Located in Willis Library; use the central staircase, any corner stairwell, or the main elevator from the first floor.

cards.title: Willis Library Study Pods
cards.subtitle: Willis Library · quiet semi-private seating
cards.notes: Reserve a pod when you want an enclosed, semi-private setup; these small spaces seat two to four and follow Willis quiet-study expectations.
cards.short_summary: Enclosed pods distributed through Willis for quieter, semi-private work.
cards.evidence_claim: UNT Libraries says Willis study pods are small enclosed spaces for semi-private study, seat 2–4 people, and are designated for quiet individual study.
cards.source_title: Willis Library: Study Pods | UNT University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Located throughout Willis Library; reservation is available through the library's pod-reservation link.

cards.title: Willis Library First Floor
cards.subtitle: Willis Library · social study setting
cards.notes: Set up at a table, casual seat, computer, or mobile whiteboard when your work benefits from a lively shared floor and nearby library services.
cards.short_summary: A social study floor with tables, seating, whiteboards, and computers.
cards.evidence_claim: UNT Libraries describes Willis Library's first floor as a social study area with study tables, casual seating, mobile whiteboards, and computers.
cards.source_title: Willis Library: First Floor | UNT University Libraries
cards.access_notes: This is a social-designated floor; UNT advises visitors to expect conversations and electronic-device noise.

cards.title: Willis Library Third Floor
cards.subtitle: Willis Library · books, tables, and workstations
cards.notes: Bring a book search or laptop to the third floor, where general collections sit alongside study tables, casual seating, and computer workstations.
cards.short_summary: A collaborative floor combining library collections with varied study seating.
cards.evidence_claim: UNT Libraries states that Willis Library's third floor has general collections, study tables, casual seating, and computer workstations in a collaborative setting.
cards.source_title: Willis Library: Third Floor | UNT University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Collaborative-designated floor; the official page notes that the lower level is Willis's designated quiet floor.

cards.title: Willis Library Fourth Floor
cards.subtitle: Willis Library · music and special-collections floor
cards.notes: Choose a carrel, table, casual seat, workstation, or music keyboard on this floor; keep group work considerate in its collaborative environment.
cards.short_summary: A collaborative fourth floor with varied seating, workstations, and music resources.
cards.evidence_claim: UNT Libraries says most of Willis Library's fourth floor is collaborative study space with pods, carrels, tables, casual seating, computer workstations, and music keyboards.
cards.source_title: Willis Library: Fourth Floor | UNT University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Fourth floor of Willis Library; it houses the Music Library and Special Collections.

cards.title: Sarah T. Hughes Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Willis Library Room 437 · Special Collections research
cards.notes: Exit the fourth-floor elevator, cross to the opposite side, and enter through the glass door for reading tables and physical-collections research.
cards.short_summary: A 14-seat reading room for Special Collections research and exhibits.
cards.evidence_claim: UNT Libraries identifies Room 437 as a fourth-floor reading room with reading tables and comfortable chairs that is the primary space for research with rare or fragile physical collection items.
cards.source_title: Willis Library: Sarah T. Hughes Reading Room (Room 437) | UNT University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Fourth floor of Willis Library; the room regularly hosts Special Collections exhibits and is designated collaborative.

cards.entity_name: Edna Mae Sandborn Music Reading Room
cards.title: Edna Mae Sandborn Music Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Willis Library Room 430A · music research
cards.notes: From the fourth-floor elevator, turn hard left and head toward the southeast stairwell to use the reading table beside rare music materials.
cards.short_summary: An eight-seat music reading room and exhibit space with rare scores and books.
cards.evidence_claim: UNT Libraries says the Edna Mae Sandborn Music Reading Room houses rare music scores and books and serves as a reading room for music researchers; it has a reading table and eight seats.
cards.source_title: Willis Library: Edna Mae Sandborn Music Reading Room (Room 430A) | UNT University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Located on the fourth floor of Willis Library; UNT directs visitors to contact Music Library staff for appointments and tours.

cards.title: Sycamore Library First Floor
cards.subtitle: Sycamore Hall · collaborative group work
cards.notes: Use the movable furniture and whiteboards for a group session, or choose one of the Windows, macOS, and laptop hardware options on the floor.
cards.short_summary: A collaborative Sycamore Hall floor with whiteboards, flexible furniture, and computers.
cards.evidence_claim: UNT Libraries describes Sycamore Library's first floor as a collaborative group-study environment with multiple whiteboards, movable furniture, Windows and macOS workstations, laptops, and group study areas.
cards.source_title: Sycamore Library: First Floor | UNT University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Located in Sycamore Library at Sycamore Hall; it is a collaborative-designated space.

cards.title: Sycamore Library Group Study Room 110A
cards.subtitle: Sycamore Hall · reservable presentation room
cards.notes: Reserve Room 110A for a presentation run-through or group work session; it has mobile seating, a presenter station, and projection connections.
cards.short_summary: A 14-seat reservable classroom for group study and presentations.
cards.evidence_claim: UNT Libraries identifies Sycamore First Floor Room 110A as a small classroom for presentations and group study that faculty, staff, and students can reserve; it seats 14.
cards.source_title: Sycamore Library: First Floor | UNT University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Located on the first floor of Sycamore Library in Sycamore Hall; reservation is available through the library's space-reservations link.

cards.title: Sycamore Library Group Study Room 110B
cards.subtitle: Sycamore Hall · reservable presentation room
cards.notes: Reserve Room 110B when your group needs movable seating plus a presenter station, projector, and HDMI/VGA connections for shared work.
cards.short_summary: A second 14-seat reservable classroom for presentations and group study.
cards.evidence_claim: UNT Libraries identifies Sycamore First Floor Room 110B as a small classroom for presentations and group study that faculty, staff, and students can reserve; it seats 14.
cards.source_title: Sycamore Library: First Floor | UNT University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Located on the first floor of Sycamore Library in Sycamore Hall; reservation is available through the library's space-reservations link.
